description: Lethonos wears a long ivory noble tunic with gold-trimmed center front, neckline, cuffs and hem. A deep plum layered robe and shoulder drape have rich gold geometric and floral woven borders. A round jeweled brooch fastens the drape at one shoulder. A decorated belt has a central red-stone metal clasp and long fringed hanging ends. Dark brown trousers tuck into brown ankle boots with narrow gold decoration. Both hands rest together at the waist and both feet are visible. The outfit is fully opaque, without headgear, armor or weapons.
